quarterly_data.quarter: Microchip Technology press release: Microchip Expands Data Center Portfolio to Meet Evolving AI (10-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Microchip expanded its data center portfolio: the new Switchtec PCIe 6.0 Low-Lane-Count (LLC) switch provides up to 64 PCIe Gen 6 lanes, 32 ports and x2, x4, x8 and x16 bifurcation with integrated DMA, PCIe Multicast and partitioning, hardware root of trust and secure boot, extending Gen 6 to space- and power-constrained data center and intelligent edge platforms; an enhanced Flashtec PCIe Gen 5 NVMe 5016 SSD controller adds CNSA 2.0 support and dual-port capability; and the Adaptec SmartRAID 4300 NVMe RAID storage accelerators add self-encrypting drive support with local and remote key management and RAID 6 and RAID 60 options. Pricing and availability vary by device (no dates stated). Brian McCarson (CVP and GM, data center solutions business unit): 'By continuing to expand our portfolio, we're providing the building blocks needed to create more efficient, secure and adaptable platforms.'
quarterly_data.figure: Switchtec PCIe 6.0 LLC switch: up to 64 PCIe Gen 6 lanes, 32 ports; Flashtec NVMe 5016 adds CNSA 2.0
